_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. On a phone not signed in: Register a new venue with an email that has no venue. Go should then open only on Account checks, every time it is opened, until every step is done. 2. Register with an email that already has a venue: Go should say which venue and offer Open it or Use another email, and never open that venue by itself. 3. Account checks: your business; Verify my identity (Stripe's ID and selfie, in the app); Business and bank checks (Stripe's screens in the app, with no Stripe sign-in page); Add a card (14 days free): closing the card screen without a card must leave the licence step to do. 4. When every step is done, set your manager PIN, then Start using Vesopa Go and sign in with that PIN. 5. A device of a venue with tills: How will this be used? now moves like the setup screen. While the back office's Stripe is in test mode, use Stripe's test ID images and card 4242 4242 4242 4242.
release_notes: Sign a new venue up in the app: verify your identity and your business with Stripe without leaving Vesopa Go, add the card for your 14 days free, then set your manager PIN. The device choice screen is animated.
